checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One eight-second 16:9 video with no audio
must.why: Frames are widescreen (832x512) and the clip is 8s. Audio cannot be checked, but none was requested and the agent said there was none.

must.item: First five seconds visually match the previous video's opening
must.why: The edited opening is a different scene. At 0.8s it shows a notebook on the desk and the plane already over it. The framing, room layout and camera differ. At 3.2s the shot is blurry and unlike the original.

must.item: Final three seconds: same white plane lands on an open notebook on the wooden desk
must.why: The plane is a similar shape, but it ends up on a large white sheet or pad of paper. No clear open notebook is visible at the end. The scene is also unlike the original.

must.item: Plane rests on the notebook rather than the bare desk
must.why: The plane rests on a white paper surface, not an identifiable open notebook. It is not on the bare desk either.

must.item: Sunny study and style consistent across the edit, no text
must.why: The look degrades into a blurry, soft, less sunny and less detailed style. There is no text, but the lighting and the style are not consistent with the original.

faults.what: The first five seconds were re-staged. The notebook is already present at 0.8s, and the camera path and composition differ from the original.
The final surface is a large white sheet or pad, not a clearly open blank notebook.
The look turns blurry and soft, with less sun and lower fidelity than the original.
A floating black dot appears at 3.2s, and a pedestal-like white block sits under the plane. These look like AI artefacts.
The plane looks odd and flat, with a swept-wing geometry that shifts across the frames.

summary: The edit gave a re-drawn, blurrier clip. The opening no longer matches the original, and the plane ends on a white paper pad rather than a clearly open notebook.
